digest.component_or_area: store git operations and locking subsystem
propositions: MANY local rebar agent processes contend concurrently on shared git operations against `.git/index.lock` and ref locks, surfacing errors to the calling agent instead of being absorbed

Bounded local-only git call sites lack explicit contention policy: _commands/compact.py, _commands/delete.py, _commands/fsck.py, _commands/txn.py, _store/event_append.py, metrics/blame.py, metrics/git_metrics.py are either unbounded or lack jitter

Transient lock conflicts (index.lock, ref locks held briefly by peers) must resolve silently with automatic retry+backoff, not escalate to the agent; only genuinely stuck locks (bounded budget exhausted) surface one actionable error

Per-store advisory flock serializes local-only git invocations; jittered retry on git's own lock signatures (cannot lock ref, *.lock File exists) with tens-of-seconds budget; uncontended fast path has zero added latency
